limitations_noted: Source acceptance audit only; synthetic development data (split='development', synthetic=true) with no verified real-world competence, gold labels, or generalization claim.

Summary-vs-timeline tenure scope ambiguities remain under HR-SOURCE-008 (C01, C02, C03, C04, C05, C06, C08 show rounded durations or summaries aligning with current role while excluding prior internship/probation periods); escalate to human review if label-material against IT-J10-R01.

Normalized top-level skills arrays omit prose qualifiers ('C++ cơ bản', 'Docker cơ bản', 'PyTorch (cơ bản)', 'ONNX Runtime (suy luận mô hình)'); downstream labeling must rely on section text rather than treating skill strings as mastery.

IT-J10-C07 has 199 whitespace-delimited tokens (1 token shy of the 200-450 preferred guideline) and an undated freelance engagement E02 (start_date=null, end_date=null, is_current=null), which may require human review if tenure thresholds under IT-J10-R01 are label-material.

Recurring candidate-index scenario templates (including C07 undated freelance pattern across jobs) and cross-job fictional employer reuse (C03, C07) limit source-family independence; retained for development pilot only under HR-SOURCE-009.
Fictionality of synthetic Vietnamese employer names is audited against known real-institution collisions without exhaustive external business-registry verification (HR-SOURCE-007).
